description:
Cost of a drone light show of N drones: every published per-drone price x drones (best match for the country first, peak-date prices only when peak=true), plus the published whole shows closest in drone count (NEVER scaled to your size; implied per drone = show price / stated drones), the same-country span, a check of a quote the buyer received (per drone vs the published range in that currency) and too_few_receipts when fewer than 3 prices apply to the country. Every price has source_url and as_of. Same maths as whirrwork.com/tools/drone-show-cost/. Currencies are NEVER converted. Not a quote and not a Whirrwork estimate: say so.
Examples: {"drones":200,"country":"US"}; {"drones":100,"country":"GB","quote":9000,"currency":"GBP"}; {"drones":500,"country":"CN"}.

drones.description: Number of drones in the show

language.description: Language for use-case text (machine-translated; English is authoritative). Default en.

peak.description: Peak date (e.g. July 4th, New Year's Eve): include peak-date prices

quote.description: Total price the buyer was quoted, to check against published prices

name: estimate_drone_show_cost

selected.description: Best-matching per-drone price applied to your drone count (null when none applies)

title: Drone light show cost
